entities.summary: Gustavo Alfonso Ayón Aguirre is a Mexican politician and former professional basketball player. He represented the senior Mexican national basketball team in international national team competitions. Standing at a height of 6 ft 10 in (2.08 m), he played at the center position. Ayon is a two−time All-EuroLeague Second Team selection.
